name: SmartVP Video Player – MP4, YouTube & Vimeo
author: alaazaoug

sections.description:
SmartVP Video Player puts your own MP4 files, YouTube videos and Vimeo videos in one clean, responsive player built on Plyr. Create a player once, shape it while a live preview updates, and place it anywhere with a shortcode.

Quality and speed menus, multiple caption tracks, a custom control bar, play on scroll and a download button are all part of this free plugin.

Made for

  • Course and tutorial sites that host their own MP4 lessons.
  • Product and landing pages where a video should start as it scrolls into view.
  • Portfolios mixing vertical, square and wide clips.

Key features

  • One player for three sources: self-hosted or direct-link MP4, YouTube and Vimeo, with the same look and controls.
  • No black bars: “Original size” takes each video’s own shape. Fixed 16:9, 4:3, 21:9, 1:1, 9:16 or a custom ratio are available too.
  • Play on scroll: start muted when the player comes into view and pause when it leaves, with an adjustable threshold.
  • Live preview: see the size, corners and control bar change as you edit, before you save.
  • Custom control bar: choose and order any of 15 Plyr controls by drag and drop or with the keyboard.
  • Captions, quality and speed (MP4): several WebVTT caption tracks, a quality menu for multiple MP4 files, and the playback speeds you choose.
  • Lighter YouTube: YouTube shows a poster and loads its player only when the visitor presses play (or autoplay or play on scroll starts it).
  • Download button: optional, with your own download link if you like (MP4).
  • Playback options: autoplay (muted), loop, preload, start time, seek step, disable pause, and pause other players on the page.
  • Size and shape: max width, max height and corner radius per player, with site-wide defaults.
  • Video SEO: VideoObject structured data for players that have a poster image.
  • Editor checks: warnings for broken links, a link that does not match the source, and a start time past the end.
  • One-click duplicate, and translation ready.

How it works

  1. Go to SmartVP Video Player → Add New Player and pick a source.
  2. Upload an MP4 or paste a YouTube or Vimeo link, then adjust the player while the preview updates.
  3. Publish and copy the shortcode, for example [smart_video id="123"], into any post, page, widget or page builder that accepts shortcodes.

Performance and privacy

  • Player files load only on pages that show a player.
  • Plyr and every icon ship with the plugin; nothing is loaded from a CDN.
  • Videos preload only their metadata by default.
  • The plugin does not track visitors, sends nothing to its author, and shows no ads or upgrade notices in your dashboard.

Accessibility

  • Plyr’s keyboard-accessible controls, labelled play buttons, and captions output as real <track> elements.
  • The control bar editor works with the keyboard.
  • Visitors who turn on “reduce motion” in their system never get a video starting on its own as they scroll.

Optional add-ons

SmartVP Lite and Pro are separate plugins that add sources (Wistia, Streamable, HLS, DASH, private Amazon S3) and tools such as playlists, password protection, and hero, popup and sticky players. Everything described above works without them.

For developers

The player exposes PHP filters and a small JavaScript API (window.SmartVP) for adding sources, render modes and features from another plugin or theme. The full list is documented at the top of includes/extend.php.

External services

The plugin contacts the services below only when a player uses them. It sends nothing to the plugin author.

YouTube (Google)

Used when a player’s source is YouTube.

  • In the visitor’s browser: the YouTube embed (https://www.youtube.com/embed/…) and IFrame Player API (https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api) load when the visitor presses play, or when autoplay or play on scroll starts the video. The default poster comes from https://i.ytimg.com/. YouTube receives the video ID, your site’s address and normal browser data (IP address, user agent).
  • From your server: YouTube’s oEmbed endpoint (https://www.youtube.com/oembed) is asked for the video’s size. Only the video URL is sent; the answer is cached for a day.

YouTube Terms of Service and Google Privacy Policy.

Vimeo

Used when a player’s source is Vimeo.

  • In the visitor’s browser: the Vimeo player (https://player.vimeo.com/video/…, with Vimeo’s “do not track” option) and Player API (https://player.vimeo.com/api/player.js) load with the page that shows the player. Vimeo receives the video ID, your site’s address and normal browser data.
  • From your server: Vimeo’s oEmbed endpoint (https://vimeo.com/api/oembed.json) is asked for the thumbnail and size. Only the video URL is sent; the answer is cached for a day.

Vimeo Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Link check in the editor

While an editor types a video URL, the plugin can check from your server that the link answers: one small request, only for YouTube and Vimeo addresses, your own site, or links ending in a video file extension. Nothing else is sent. It runs only in wp-admin, for users who can upload files.

Third-party libraries

All bundled locally; nothing is loaded from a CDN.

  • Plyr 3.8.4 — MIT License. vendor/plyr/plyr.js is the unminified build of the plyr.min.js the plugin loads.
  • Codestar Framework 2.3.1 — GPLv2 or later. Used for the player settings and metabox screens; trimmed to the fields this plugin uses. Unminified sources are included next to the minified files.
  • Font Awesome 4.7.0 — fonts SIL OFL 1.1, CSS MIT. Section icons in the settings screens.
sections.installation:
1. In your dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New Plugin, search for “SmartVP Video Player”, then click Install Now and Activate.
  2. Open SmartVP Video Player → Add New Player.
  3. Choose a source: Direct MP4 / Self-hosted, YouTube or Vimeo.
  4. Upload an MP4 from your Media Library, or paste the video’s link. A poster image is optional.
  5. Watch the preview at the top of the screen as you adjust the look and behaviour, then click Publish.
  6. Copy the shortcode from the player screen or the players list, and paste it into a Shortcode block, the classic editor, a widget or a page-builder shortcode element.

To install manually, upload the smartvp-video-player folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it on the Plugins screen.
sections.faq:
Is there a Gutenberg block?

Not yet. In the block editor, add a Shortcode block and paste the player’s shortcode.

Which video files work best?

Use MP4 files with H.264 video and AAC audio; they play in every current browser. Large files usually load faster from a CDN or object storage link than from shared hosting.

Why does autoplay start muted?

Browsers only allow a video to start on its own when it is muted, so autoplay and play on scroll always start muted. Visitors can turn the sound on. Some phones in battery-saving mode block autoplay entirely.

How do I show a vertical (9:16) video without black bars?

Set Aspect Ratio to Original (match the video, no bars), or choose 9:16. Use Max width to stop a vertical video from filling the whole column.

Can I add subtitles or captions?

Yes, for MP4 players. Upload one or more WebVTT (.vtt) files, give each a label and language, and choose a default track. YouTube and Vimeo videos use the captions set on those platforms.

Can I hide YouTube’s related videos and logo?

SmartVP shows its own control bar over YouTube videos and asks YouTube to suggest only videos from the same channel. YouTube controls its logo and end-of-video suggestions, so they cannot be removed completely.

Can I set defaults for every player?

Yes. SmartVP Video Player → Settings has the site-wide aspect ratio, corner radius and the “pause other players” option. A player’s own settings take priority.

Is there a premium version?

Optional Lite and Pro add-ons are sold separately and add further sources and display modes. Everything listed on this page works without them.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

Deleting the plugin from the Plugins screen removes its players, their settings and its cached data.

Where can I get help?

Post in the support forum. Please include the player’s source type and a link to the page if you can.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • First release on WordPress.org, under the new name SmartVP Video Player (previously Smart Video Player).
  • Updated Plyr to 3.8.4 and the bundled Codestar Framework to 2.3.1.
  • Font Awesome is now bundled locally; the admin screens no longer load anything from a CDN, and the editor preview uses the local Plyr icons.
  • All functions, hooks, options and meta keys now use the smartvp_ prefix. Existing settings and players are migrated automatically on update.
  • Add-on features moved out of this plugin into the add-ons. New extension hooks (PHP filters and the window.SmartVP JavaScript API) let add-ons register sources, render modes and player features.
  • The quality menu now works for Direct MP4 players.
  • Security: database queries in uninstall and migration use prepared statements; unused framework AJAX handlers removed.

1.0.8

  • Player corner rounding, per player or site-wide.
  • Fixes for Vimeo cropping and Original size.

1.0.5

  • New “Original” aspect ratio that sizes the player to the video, and a site-wide default ratio.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.

upgrade_notice.1.1.0: Coming from "Smart Video Player"? Deactivate and delete it first. Settings and players are migrated to new option and meta names automatically. If you use the Lite or Pro add-on, update it to its latest version at the same time.

screenshots.caption: A self-hosted MP4 with captions and the settings menu: captions, quality and speed in one place.
The player editor: pick a source and watch the live preview update as you edit.
The control bar editor: drag the controls you want into place, in any order.
Behaviour settings: play on scroll with its threshold, muted start, loop, preload and start time.
All players in one list, each with a ready-to-copy shortcode.
Site-wide defaults: pause other players, default aspect ratio and corner radius.
